modules.name: Vlad Multiplayer
modules.abstract: Play KSP with friends: the VMP multiplayer client with career-mode sync, built for the VMP Train Career server.
modules.description:
VMP (Vlad Multiplayer) lets you play Kerbal Space Program with friends in one shared universe. Career mode is kept in sync between everyone on the server: funds, science and contracts.

It is a fork of Luna Multiplayer for KSP 1.12, and it is built for the VMP Train Career server.

To join a server you need the exact matching build of the client. The VMP Launcher pack installs the right one for you.
modules.author: Rjwolfe44
